description: List the documents a company listed on B3 delivered to its securities regulator, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:WEGE3), newest first, from 2003: material facts, market notices, financial statements, earnings releases, analyst presentations, shareholder meeting documents and its other disclosures. Each row gives the delivery date, the kind of document in English (marked resubmitted when it replaces an earlier one), the company's own description, mostly in Portuguese, and a link that opens the PDF on its Equibles page. Narrow with query, whose words must all appear in the description or kind (e.g. 'material fact', 'dividendos'), and a date range. The documents' text is not searchable: ListFilings, SearchDocuments and ReadDocumentLines cover SEC filings and transcripts, which a Brazilian company has only when it also files with the SEC. For reported figures use GetFinancialStatement.

query.description: Optional words (at most 6) that must all appear in the description or the kind of document, in any case, e.g. 'material fact', 'financial statements', 'assembleia'.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:WEGE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.
